class.name: BasisSpreener
class.brief_description: Interpolates an [Object]'s [Basis] property based on the damping ratio and halflife of a spring.
class.description: [BasisSpreener] is used to interpolate a [Basis] property of an object. See [method Spreen.spreen_basis]. [b]Note:[/b] [method Spreen.spreen_basis] is the only correct way to create [BasisSpreener]. Any [BasisSpreener] created manually will not function correctly.

method.name: update_goal
method.description: Updates the goal of the [BasisSpreener] in real time. When used in tandem with [method Spreen.set_finishable] can be used to dampen noisy inputs.
